summary: Full E2E testing of P1 AI file-upload feature (backend + frontend). 21/22 backend pytest tests pass (the 1 failure is a shell env-var quoting issue in my test — TTL index was verified directly via pymongo: expireAfterSeconds=86400 on created_at). All frontend UI flows verified via Playwright: paperclip renders on Zyntha/Thoro/Zyona/Assist, upload chip flow works, multi-file upload works, unsupported .txt and >10MB files show toasts and do not create chips, and the AI reply contains the expected 'Gadget' answer derived from the uploaded CSV context.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3023 lines — consider splitting AI upload/chat routes into a dedicated router module.

In /api/ai/upload, whitespace-only CSVs still succeed because the csv module returns the whitespace text; the '422 No text extracted' guard only triggers on strictly empty text. Not a bug per spec (acceptable proxy for scan-only files), but worth documenting.
TestChatWithFiles.sales_upload uses a class-scoped fixture defined as instance method — pytest emits a PendingDeprecationWarning. Cosmetic only.
test_credentials: Founder regie@myrootzz.com / Zynthoro2026! (2FA disabled, unlimited); Demo jury@zynthoro.ai / ZynthoroDemo2026! (used for cross-user isolation).
seed_data_creation: None — tests generate ephemeral CSV/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF in-memory and delete uploads at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run E2E backend suite with: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_ai_upload_e2e.py -v`. Requires internet-reachable emergentintegrations (Claude+Gemini). Chat tests take ~15s total. TTL index sanity check was done via pymongo directly: db.ai_uploads has index 'created_at_1' with expireAfterSeconds=86400. Cross-user isolation confirmed — demo user passing founder's file_id gets a reply that does NOT include the CSV rows. All four assistants (zyona, zyntha, thoro, zynthoro_assist) correctly answered 'Gadget' when given the sales CSV.
verified_backend_tests: POST /api/ai/upload rejects empty file with 400 'File is empty.'
POST /api/ai/upload rejects >10MB file with 413 'File too large (max 10 MB).'
POST /api/ai/upload for CSV/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF returns file_id, filename, size, mime, chars_extracted, truncated, preview — with real extracted text
DELETE /api/ai/upload/{file_id} owner-scoped: owner OK, non-existent 404, other user 404
POST /api/ai/chat with file_ids across zyona/zyntha/thoro/zynthoro_assist correctly answers 'Gadget'
POST /api/ai/stream with file_ids emits delta frames containing 'Gadget'
Cross-user isolation: demo user passing founder's file_id receives reply that does NOT echo the CSV rows
TTL index expireAfterSeconds=86400 on ai_uploads.created_at (verified via pymongo)
verified_frontend_flows: Paperclip button + hidden file input render on /dashboard/zyntha, /dashboard/thoro, /dashboard/zyona
AttachmentChip renders in pending row after upload and clears after send
User bubble displays per-message attachment chips (zyona-msg-{i}-attachments)
AI reply contains 'Gadget' after uploading sales CSV to Zyona and asking about highest revenue
.txt files show Sonner toast 'Only PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX or CSV files are supported.' and no chip is created
>10MB files show toast 'File is too large. Maximum size is 10 MB.' and no chip is created
Multi-file upload: two CSVs selected → two chips render simultaneously
Zynthoro Assist floating panel: assist-attach-btn / assist-file-input / assist-pending-attachments all functional
